components.css: .ds-panel{width:360px;border-radius:16px;background:#fff;color:#14171d;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px #e4e7ec,0 6px 24px rgb(15 20 30 / .05);font-family:'IBM Plex Sans',system-ui,sans-serif;overflow:hidden}.ds-q{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;padding:16px 20px;font-size:20px;font-weight:300;border-bottom:1px solid rgb(15 20 30 / .07)}.ds-q span{font-size:12px;color:#5f6672}.ds-panel ul{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:6px}.ds-panel li{display:grid;gap:2px;padding:8px 12px;border-radius:8px;transition:background-color .15s}.ds-panel li:not(.on):hover{background:rgb(20 23 29 / .04)}.ds-panel li.on{background:rgb(31 95 214 / .12)}.ds-panel li.on b{color:#1f5fd6}.ds-panel b{font-size:14px;font-weight:400}.ds-panel i{font-style:normal;font-size:12px;color:#5f6672}.ds-foot{padding:9px 16px;border-top:1px solid rgb(15 20 30 / .07);font-size:11.5px;color:#5f6672}

narrative.overview: The page is a white desk with one real instrument on it: the extension's own search panel, scaled up and left to run. Nothing on the page explains that the panel does not already show. Headlines are large Instrument Serif set on a plain surface; everything that behaves like software is IBM Plex and uses the exact light and dark colour sets from the extension's stylesheet.
keyCharacteristics: White page, one blue accent, hairline borders instead of fills.
The product UI is the illustration; mock panels share the real extension's parts and values.
Serif italic in the accent blue marks the one emphasised word of a headline.
Light and dark are equal citizens, switched with a data attribute and a 0.5s colour cross-fade.
Large radii on panels (16 to 20px), small on controls (6 to 10px).

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Blue means "selected or matched" and nothing else. Do not use it for decoration, section colour, or illustration.

rules.name: The Extension Parity Rule
rules.body: Colour values for light and dark are copied from the extension's own stylesheet and stay in lockstep with it. Change them there first.

rules.name: The Tint, Not Fill Rule
rules.body: Hover, selection, highlight, band and code backgrounds are the foreground or blue mixed into transparent (4 to 38%), never a new hex.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Serif is for headlines and step numerals only. Anything interactive, however large, is Plex.

rules.name: The Italic Accent Rule
rules.body: At most one italic blue word per headline.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Borders are inset 1px line-colour rings, not CSS borders, except dividers inside panels.

rules.name: The Keycap Only Rule
rules.body: A hard bottom edge belongs to key caps and nothing else.

dos: Do show the real panel parts (query row, rows, footer, kbd chips) wherever a feature is explained.
Do keep light and dark values identical to the extension's stylesheet and test both themes.
Do build borders as inset 1px rings in the line colour.
Do keep copy short and plain, with one lead sentence under a headline.
Do keep a 2px blue focus outline with 2px offset on every interactive element.
Do give every moving element a reduced-motion path.
donts: Don't add a second accent colour, gradients, or colour for decoration.
Don't use serif for buttons, labels, or panel text.
Don't put hard or offset shadows on anything except key caps.
Don't add testimonials, counts, ratings or benchmarks; none exist.
Don't drift toward generic AI-made looks: no glow blobs, gradient headlines, or icon-in-circle feature grids.
